title: A set that coincides with x + V near x has approximate tangent space V at x
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let M ⊆ Euclid P be an arbitrary set, x ∈ Euclid P, V a linear subspace of Euclid P with finrank V = n, and δ > 0. Suppose that every z ∈ Euclid P with dist(z, x) < δ satisfies z ∈ M ⟺ z − x ∈ V. Then V is the approximate tangent space of M at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, 1.4, as formalized by SimonGMT's HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x V. That is, finrank V = n, and for every f ∈ C_c(Euclid P, ℝ), ∫_{η_{x,r}(M)} f dHⁿ → ∫_V f dHⁿ as r → 0⁺, where η_{x,r}(y) = blowUpMap x r y = r⁻¹(y − x) and Hⁿ = μHE[n].
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (δ : ℝ), Module.finrank ℝ V = n → 0 < δ → (∀ z : Euclid P, dist z x < δ → (z ∈ M ↔ z - x ∈ V)) → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x V
